short: Investigation on mechanical properties and creep behavior of
title: Investigation on mechanical properties and creep behavior of stir cast AZ91-SiCp composites

lanes.label: Classical tools
lanes.sub: collapsed to one node per state

states.title: Hypothesis and design
states.head: Cast Mg alloy AZ91 needs higher strength and creep resistance at elevated temperature. Adding SiC particles by stir casting should raise the strength and creep resistance of AZ91.
states.detail: Absorbed: n1 (HYP/need), n2 (HYP/hypothesis), n3 (DES/base_system), n4 (DES/modification), n5 (DES/variable_sweep), n6 (PRC/forming)

states.title: Structure state
states.head: SiCp near-uniformly dispersed in the matrix with few agglomerates, local clusters around grains. Clean, reaction-free Mg/SiCp interface with intimate bonding.
states.detail: Absorbed: n7 (STR/microstructure/distribution), n8 (STR/interface), n9 (STR/microstructure/feature_size). Premises: Compo-cast AZ91/SiC studies: SiC is well wetted by Mg, Al improves wettability

states.title: Property state and mechanisms
states.head: SiCp act as heterogeneous nucleation sites and restrict Mg grain growth during solidification. Particle strengthening (SiCp blocking dislocations), load transfer and grain refinement raise yield strength.
states.detail: Absorbed: n11 (MEC/pathway), n12 (MEC/pathway), n13 (PRP/value), n16 (PRP/value), n18 (MEC/pathway), n17 (PRP/diagnostic), n19 (MEC/identification). Premises: Threshold-stress power law: creep rate ~ (sigma - sigma_thr)^n_t; n=3 viscous glide; n=5 high-temperature climb (lattice diffusion); n=7 low-temperature climb (core diffusion); n=8 lattice-diffusion creep

states.title: Performance state
states.head: Improved creep resistance at 175 C and 80-120 MPa for composites with >=15 wt% SiCp

states.title: Conclusion
states.head: SiCp refines AZ91 grains, raises yield and compressive strength, and at >=15 wt% improves creep resistance via a threshold stress

nodes.title: MICRO, F1
nodes.head: Grain network clear only in panel a; in b-f boundaries are at most faintly traced (c) and not measurable
nodes.solves: Matrix grains refined from 65 um (AZ91) to 34 um (5 wt%) and 22 um (10 wt%), ~21 um at 25 wt%
